//: Sample 'nodeStream' block for myseliasan (the control plane). It configures

nodeStream.//publicIps: Parent's externally reachable IP(s), advertised as host candidates (NAT 1:1) so a browser on another network reaches the parent directly. Leave [] / omit on a LAN.
nodeStream.//udpPort: Bind a single shared WebRTC UDP port for all browser peers (open just this one port in the firewall). 0 / omit = pion's default ephemeral ports.
nodeStream.//iceServers: STUN/TURN offered to the browser. STUN helps discover the public path; a TURN server is needed only when the parent is itself behind NAT (browser<->parent media then relays through TURN). Omit / [] on a LAN.
